verified: M451 directed VCS, M452 independent VCS, M439 reference DC, M455 candidate DC, M447 cycle DSE, and M449 independent cycle-review inner and outer seals all verify with zero mismatch.

The M451 candidate and sealed M433 reference use the same Design Compiler V-2023.12-SP3 binary, exact Tcl SHA, exact 3 ns SDC SHA, slow-max and fast-min library SHAs, ssg0p9v125c operating condition, ideal clock, ZeroWireload, and zero macros.

M451 raw reports/netlist independently reproduce 12,952.043867 um2, 12,802 cells, 1,445 sequential cells and exactly 1,445 mapped DFFs, 42 logic levels, setup +0.8828 ns, hold +0.0251 ns, zero macro/blackbox/latch/timing-loop/constraint violations, and nonempty mapped netlist/SDC/DDC/SVF.

Sealed M433 raw reports/netlist independently reproduce 8,351.405814 um2, 7,139 cells, 1,348 sequential cells and exactly 1,348 mapped DFFs, 52 logic levels, setup +0.8411 ns, hold +0.0251 ns, and the same zero hard-gate findings.
Ratios independently recompute to M451/M433 area 1.550881870126303, cells 1.793248354111220, and FF 1.071958456973294. M451 adds 4,600.638053 um2, of which 4,380.642064 um2 is combinational.

The sealed M449 K1 opportunity independently reproduces 517,041,352/430,154,216 = 1.201990664668971. Dividing by the standalone area ratio gives 0.775036892120662 opportunity-throughput per area, 22.4963% below M433.

M451's 13-bit x96 output plus one fused flag explains exactly 97 additional FFs over M433's 12-bit x96 output; the dominant cost is the 96-lane signed pre-adder combinational logic rather than hidden state.
Both mapping runs applied 0.125 ns hold uncertainty, restored the 0.100 ns publication uncertainty before final reports and mapped SDC, and report the same +0.0251 ns final worst hold slack.

issues.finding: The central low-incremental-cost condition from M449 is falsified at standalone logic level: +55.0882% area buys only a +20.1991% unadmitted trace-cycle opportunity, yielding 0.7750368921x opportunity-throughput per area.
issues.required_action: Remove M451 from the DATE performance and Synopsys critical path. Archive its mapped artifact and do not run standalone Formality or PrimeTime unless an integrated amortization screen first produces a Pareto-surviving point.

issues.finding: A fused M451 cycle consumes 160 bytes of physical PWP input plus 96 bytes of correction input, or 256 bytes total, versus M433's 160-byte wide input. Neither top includes SRAM macros, bank conflicts, address generation, wires, or interconnect.
issues.required_action: Require a matched 256-byte delivery model with bank/address/interconnect area and timing before treating 1.2019906647x as executable hardware opportunity.

issues.finding: M451-versus-M433 is not an integrated iso-function area comparison. M433's denominator excludes the separate correction execution resource whose cycles are supposedly removed, while M451 still excludes persistent old_psum accumulation and any remaining nonfused correction path.
issues.required_action: Only an integrated baseline-versus-fused top may price amortization: include M433 plus separate correction resources on the baseline, and include fused plus residual correction, old_psum, commit, and equal ports on the candidate.

issues.finding: Design Compiler emits six VER-318 signed-to-unsigned assignment warnings on the exact signed arithmetic assignments. Exhaustive VCS is strong RTL evidence but does not prove synthesis preserved those semantics.
issues.required_action: If and only if an integrated screen rescues the point, make signed casts/destination types unambiguous and run Formality from the integrated RTL to its own mapped netlist before any mapped arithmetic claim.

issues.finding: The reference is the older sealed M439 run at 07:55 and the candidate is a new M455 run at 09:08, not a paired invocation. Exact Tcl, SDC, tool, libraries, host assumptions, and seals match, so this is adequate for mechanism-local logic cost but weaker than a newly paired run for a headline comparison.
issues.required_action: Do not rerun merely for this negative point. If an integrated point survives later, synthesize baseline and candidate together in one paired exact-SHA runner.

issues.finding: Both final worst hold slacks are only +0.0251 ns after a 25 ps mapping guard. The SDC has no input transition or driving-cell constraint and uses ideal clock plus ZeroWireload.
issues.required_action: Treat setup/hold as prelayout DC evidence only. A surviving integrated top requires explicit slow-max/fast-min PrimeTime with realistic slew and later extracted clock/interconnect.

issues.finding: M451 reduces reported logic levels from 52 to 42 and improves DC setup slack by 0.0417 ns, but both adapters already have an elastic II=1 interface and the 1.20199x number comes from eliminating trace issue cycles, not raising frequency.
issues.required_action: Do not convert logic-level or slack differences into speedup. Keep timing margin and cycle opportunity as separate axes.

issues.finding: Both logs repeatedly use a fanout-of-1000 proxy for one high-fanout net; net area is zero, power is absent, and the M433 reference retains its known benign busy/debug_output_full LINT-31 alias.
issues.required_action: Do not call the cell-area ratio physical area, power, energy, or routed PPA. Resolve or waive structural aliases and high-fanout assumptions only if a future integrated point is reopened.
